scope_review: Complex linked arrangements and related-party relationships in separate versus consolidated statements, KMP/ownership, small entities and Australian tiers.

accuracy_checks.challenge: Uncharged services, KMP-controlled vendors, service side letters, milestone occurring after reporting date, guaranteed bank loan and arm's-length claim require separate evidence. Elimination in consolidated books does not remove subsidiary disclosure analysis.
accuracy_checks.reason: IAS24 disclosures separated from transaction recognition; relationship alone creates no universal fair-value measurement. UK 2026 Section1A related-party disclosure scope corroborated against FRC current primary guidance, not a blanket directors-remuneration exemption. Off-market parent funding conditional on capacity; guarantees and contingent liabilities separate.

claim_checks.proposition: Identify related-party relationships and disclose relevant transactions/balances; account for off-market financing and linked contract promises using their own measurement models.
Apply US_GAAP transaction scope, recognition, measurement, presentation, disclosure and transition to complex contracts related parties independently.
Apply UK_GAAP transaction scope, recognition, measurement, presentation, disclosure and transition to complex contracts related parties independently.
Apply AASB transaction scope, recognition, measurement, presentation, disclosure and transition to complex contracts related parties independently.
